scope: Actual RewardCatalog, RewardLedger and RewardStore execute on the host JVM with real JSON parsing. Only Android Context/SharedPreferences I/O is simulated, including failed writes and process-like restarts. This does not establish native victory callbacks, Android persistence, UI badges or gameplay.

schemaFixtureAdaptation.generatedCopyChanges: One expected schema3 literal becomes4, and its descriptive check label follows4; no economic assertions changed.

policy.completionIDs: Read from the real bundled catalog, supplied by Main to the wallet; no map prefix or display-name inference.
policy.nativeWin: Map Complete, ordinary win credits, category claim, run difficulty credits and receipt save atomically.
policy.legacyHistory: Old completed-map history is retained. Home reconciliation backfills every fully complete unclaimed group once.
policy.replayAndSaves: Persistent category flags prevent Home, replayed maps and older paid saved runs from duplicating the bonus.
policy.rollback: Failed commits roll back balance, map completion, category flags, run credits and settlement together.
